infobox.usage: Unlocks the closed section of a container behind the LexOs car dealership on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Cargo container mesh door key (Container) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the metal gate in one of the shipping containers.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Grate door inside a shipping container between the LexOs car dealership and the car workshop at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Grenade box
- 1x Weapon box (6x6)
- 1x Weapon box (6x2)
- Loose loot (Weapon mods)
